answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the nebula of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The canyon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the orchard is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, revoked by a single upheld challenge.
